Batch 12 authoring is complete for **Discrete Memoryless Channel Capacity**: 18 A-page items and 2 B-page examples, with the manifest, pages, coverage, cross-batch evidence, proof contracts, notes, and 20 current Step 1 readiness records. The records are authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

Scoped checks passed: proof contracts **20/20** with 74 exact citations and 33 step mappings; proof layout **20 items, 0 defects**; precheck **13 proof-bearing items, 0 failures**; rendercheck **22 files**; item dependency levels **20/20**, maximum level 7; and source fetch **4/4**. Coverage has no errors and one low-yield warning: 8 of 26 A-page harvested results are new items; the other dispositions are recorded for Alpha review.

The run-wide dependency check is blocked by unrelated invalid YAML in [prop-first-order-star-commutator-is-a-poisson-bracket.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/prop-first-order-star-commutator-is-a-poisson-bracket.md:22). I also recorded a scheduling discrepancy: the dispatch says batch 12 requires batch 7, while the shared artifact lists batches 4 and 7 and has a different input hash. I left shared scheduling state unchanged.
